name: agent-skills
description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
one_liner: A set of quality checklists that force an AI coding assistant to plan, build, test, and review code the way a disciplined senior engineer would, instead of dumping out sloppy first-draft code.
buyer: A startup engineering lead worried their AI-generated code is becoming bloated and hard to maintain, who wants guardrails without hiring more senior reviewers.
business_use_cases: An engineering team adopts it company-wide as their standard AI workflow, cutting code-review overhead.
A dev agency uses it as a selling point ('audited AI-quality workflow') to win more risk-averse enterprise clients.
A coding bootcamp teaches it as the 'how to actually use AI coding tools well' module of its curriculum.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a half-day onboarding workshop for engineering teams adopting AI coding tools
Offer a premium extended skill pack with more checks/integrations

steal_this: Package a half-day 'ship better AI-generated code' workshop this weekend using it as the core material, and sell it to two startups.
